correctness.rationale: Reconstructed exact random-pair decomposition Q_±=P_h±D_h, P_h=I−2hH+O(h²), D_h=h² C+O(h³), deterministic propagation e^(−2jhH), and martingale-sum representation of X_n−m_n. Orthogonality bounds centered second moments by O(jh⁴) and replacing random X_{j−1} by deterministic mean leaves L² error O(h³), negligible after h^(−3/2) scaling. Bounded triangular-array coefficients √h v(t_j) give Lindeberg and covariance h∑v vᵀ→½∫_0^L v vᵀdt, with degeneracies allowed. Positivity of the integral, invertibility of exponentials, analyticity of C exp(−tH)x0, and Cayley–Hamilton yield the exact iff CH^k x0=0 (0≤k<d). Independent exact numeric 2×2 witness C=[[0,1/2],[-1/2,0]] and covariance recursion n=30,60,120,240 tends monotonically to e^(−2)(1−e^(−2))/16=0.007313727771742408 (values 0.00687824, 0.00709158, 0.00720153, 0.00725734). We verified admissible positive-definite witness. The asymptotic is centered random-order noise only, not continuum solver error.

originality.rationale: Qualified PASS: general random matrix product central limit methods, randomized splitting rates and deterministic commutator error algebra are prior. The completed conclusion that survives is the exact weak-noise covariance at h^(3/2) for balanced pairwise implicit resolvents, including its finite vector-specific Krylov null criterion. Full Berger (1984) available rendered sections 5–6 were inspected: diffusive stochastic product limits and generic limiting semigroups do not themselves state this smaller centered noise coefficient or initial-data null equivalence. Eisenmann–Stillfjord independent-choice splitting does not require every pair to contain both operators. Search of published mathematical records returned unrelated Gaussian sign concentration/Krylov CG rather than an equivalent formula. An older generalized perturbative CLT may imply pieces; priority remains qualified.
residual_risks: Specialized older random-product perturbation CLT may imply the matrix covariance after hidden change of scaling.
The finite Krylov silence criterion is an elementary analytic consequence once an exact covariance formula is available; novelty is joint precise formula/classification, not analyticity itself.
No extension beyond constant symmetric PSD finite matrices with iid pair signs.
